title: Apocalyptic
identity: Frederick Koch’s *Apocalyptic* exists in separate Southern Music editions for soprano saxophone and piano (1995) and alto saxophone and piano (1996). The current catalog lists soprano, while its purchase link points to the alto edition; the underlying source material supports both editions, so the present mismatch is a catalog-link/instrument ambiguity rather than evidence that a soprano edition does not exist.

evidence.claim: Copyright record identifies a soprano saxophone and piano publication from 1995 and a separate alto saxophone and piano publication from 1996.
The current catalog’s Boosey link title describes the alto saxophone and piano edition; direct page was inaccessible during web retrieval.

collection_flag: Two separately published saxophone editions are documented; intended audience and performance use are unknown.
